title: Price the rounded QQ16 pair with explicit Boolean circuits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2807 provides a finite dyadic format for the zero-retention QQ16 decoder but leaves bit arithmetic open. This adds one opt-in package with a literal AND/XOR/OR/NOT circuit for its signed nearest-even Gaussian pair.

```text
four signed w-bit components + supplied binary exponent d
  -> exact signed pair numerators
  -> guard/sticky nearest-even rounding
  -> four signed L-bit outputs, L=w+2

fixed d:    52L-4d+8 gates
runtime d: 24Lk+52L+4*2^k+4k+4 gates, k=bit_length(L-2)
```

The quantified proof includes negative ties and overflow-safe widths. Conditional on PR2807's range bound, its W=456 example uses 124,028 runtime-exponent gates per pair. This gives an explicit pair-kernel subtotal, not a recursive child tariff, complete decoder invoice, optimum, reversibility claim or new kappa. Scanning, scalar ADDs/CLEARs, wrappers/maps, physical control/movement/storage and the consumer remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Task `joint-query-controller`, refined to the open bit-arithmetic obligation; draw `4019502450bee48d71d00abd483c7eb5`, priority revision 5. Scientific base `bf8db3a1c7c7da2cae0fd5a77ca228cdd2664a53`; pre-submission main `381fa07cb60fb47ceccfc353cc2891b4d17078c3` has byte-identical guidance, selected record and replay runner. Original scientific pins remain intentional.

Exact consumed dependency [PR2807](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2807) is `6fbab8c4b95cdf75dfcbb33806c31349408d73a2`, retaining [PR2771](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2771), PR2736 and ywz65's PR2707. Their numerical/native/format results are inherited; this adds literal bit gates and their invoice. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-18960295). Final overlap covers 721 open PRs at 22:53 UTC and 1,455 Discussion records at 22:55 UTC, with complete pagination and no warnings. The search excludes arbitrary diffs and unpublished work; TASK records the limits. Family decision: narrow and stop after this kernel.

## Validation

Before, the retained source explicitly leaves bit costs open. After, actual gate DAGs match an independently implemented signed-magnitude rational oracle on every four-component input for w=1..4, both signs and every legal exponent: 689,728 assignments per variant. Another 320 cases per variant cover wide registers through 1,024 bits. Six semantic controls, twelve boundary rejections and five artifact groups pass, including Git-free read-only replay and actual source/typed-receipt corruption.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-rounded-pair-bit-circuit
```

Native macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.15: normal/optimized registered replay and all five artifact groups pass. CPython 3.14.8 optimized replay, eleven replay-selection/input-path tests, package metadata/source pins, Ruff and whitespace checks pass. A separate internal mathematical/source review found no blocking issue; no independent human review, formal-kernel proof, hardware synthesis, selected cold replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

## Credit

Credit ywz65, Arham Tahir, Ali Romman, Ross Richardson and the retained QQ16/native/geometry lineage. Source snapshots preserve their notices; exact Git/SHA256 pins are included. Ripple carry, guard/sticky rounding and barrel shifts are standard. Substantial AI assistance was used in analysis, implementation and validation. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The package README and TASK identify the next test: pin an admitted recursive child and actual caller encoding, then combine the exponent scan, arithmetic, movement, restoration and consumer in one bill. Missing representation/caller costs block that transfer. Further isolated gate optimization alone does not justify a construction round.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one opt-in research package. No existing verifier or frozen predecessor is modified.
